lines.t: When I was buried in my shame
He knew my name, He knew my pain
I tried to hide behind my scars
But you came close and found my heart
And all the pieces I could not repair
You held them gently like you cared
Your love came after me
When I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark
And held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me
And I can't explain the way you see
Every broken part of me
You love me first and you still do
When I was tired of running far You never changed, you never lost heart
You stayed with me through every fall When I was weak, you carried all
And all the tears I tried to hide
You saw them fall and stayed beside me
Your love came after me
When I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark
And held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me
And I can't explain the way you see Every broken part of me
You loved me first and you still do I was wondering, you were patient
I was hurting, you were kind I was empty, you were faithful
You never left me behind
And now I know deep in my soul
There is nowhere I can go
That your love won't find me there
That your love won't find me there
That your love won't find me there
Your love came after me when I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark and held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me and I can't explain the way you see
Every broken part of me, you loved me first and you still do
Thank you so much for joining us, and we'll see you next time.
